San Francisco Planning, Article 10 landmark designation: Landmark No. 249, Music Concourse (ordinance, Planning Commission resolution and case report)
sources.label: SF Planning, landmark designation

historical_record.description: The Spreckels Temple of Music, the concourse's centrepiece, was built for the sugar magnate Claus Spreckels to designs by his architects the Reid Brothers, in Colusa sandstone with carving by Robert I. Aitken; 75,000 people came to its dedication on Admission Day, 1900, to hear Angelo Spadina's eighty-piece Park Band.
